dict.string: WhimprFlow uses your microphone to transcribe what you say into text.
WhimprFlow captures system audio locally to transcribe what other participants say. Nothing is streamed off your machine.
WhimprFlow reads your calendar to show what is coming up and to title your meeting notes. Nothing is written back and nothing leaves your machine.
